activity_summary: You ran Richard the Third from the parts for next week. Cowley entered twice on the wrong lord, because two cues both ended alike, and you changed three cue-words to Lord Hastings, my liege, and madam. Larkham copied both rolls and said nothing. Nick had his words and not the breath before the door. Burbage at half voice was still too big for the parlour. Phillips wanted Cowley to take Egeon. You refused, and you played the tale at two on breath and consonants.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Changed the three cues and refused to give up Egeon.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Checked the entrances against the plot and counted the three new words.

entities.name: Richard Cowley
entities.context: Entered twice on the wrong lord, then took the three new cues.

entities.name: Nick Sorrell
entities.context: Had the words, and was late on the breath.

entities.name: Richard Burbage
entities.context: Did the wooing at half voice, still too big for the room.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Told the room it was too large, and made no quarrel.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Heard the throat and asked that Cowley take Egeon.

entities.name: Humphrey Larkham
entities.context: Copied both rolls and did not speak.

facets.activity: Changed three cues and kept Egeon

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: Let Cowley take Egeon this afternoon.
